implementation_defects.prior_behavior: Recorded a derived request hash and output-text hash but not canonical request-body and full-response hashes.
implementation_defects.repair: Hash the canonical Responses API body as input_sha256 and the complete decoded response object as response_sha256.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Invalid model output receives an empty ranking.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: JSON or system-schema validation failure aborted the run.
implementation_defects.repair: Persist complete call provenance, mark the output invalid, and emit an empty ranking without an additional model call.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Compared systems use the same frozen candidate-code universe.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: The generic selector map exposed repository files that the frozen chunk builder excluded.
implementation_defects.repair: Build the selector map only from paths represented in the frozen candidate chunks.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: The frozen contract and prompts cannot drift before provider execution.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: The runner loaded contract and prompt files without checking their freeze-receipt hashes.
implementation_defects.repair: Reject execution unless the amended experiment contract and both frontier prompts match freeze-receipt.v2.json.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Every split unit must have one budget-valid prediction and required provenance record for every declared system.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: The evaluator rejected duplicate pairs but could score an incomplete unit-system grid.
implementation_defects.repair: Validate contract and blind-manifest hashes, complete pair coverage, code-token budgets, invalid-output emptiness, and frontier provenance before opening gold.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Confirmatory execution may occur only after the frozen development promotion gates pass.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: The runner and evaluator accepted a confirmatory split without a promotion receipt, prediction seal, or durable single-prediction evaluation lock.
implementation_defects.repair: Derive PROMOTE or KILL from sealed development predictions and evaluations, recompute that gate before confirmatory calls, and lock the first prediction at the canonical sealed-corpus path before reading gold.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Cached frontier output and provenance must remain derivable from the complete provider response.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: A cache entry could retain mutable parsed output or duplicated response metadata without re-deriving it from a raw response.
implementation_defects.repair: Persist the complete raw response and reject cache entries whose response hash, output hash, parsed JSON, response id, effective model, or usage disagrees with it.

implementation_defects.contract_requirement: Materialization must use the exact dataset artifact approved by access preflight.
implementation_defects.prior_behavior: The materializer consumed a dataset path without comparing its bytes with both the source registry and access receipt.
implementation_defects.repair: Require the source registry and reject the run unless all three dataset hashes match before any corpus unit is written.
